findings.summary: Default preferred loses the required fallback reason when the native sync OPFS API is absent. Omitted storage stays undefined, selecting initBackend’s legacy silent-memory path at packages/vfs/src/boot.ts:87; explicit preferred correctly produces a reason. Fault class: sibling-drift between omitted/default and explicit preferred. Missing RED: omitted storage with unavailable createSyncAccessHandle. Sweep the SDK/default worker-name capture alongside explicit preferred and ephemeral, preserving generic unconfigured VFS behavior.
findings.authority: Acceptance 1/2 → I1; ADR-0419: omission is preferred OPFS and fallback reason is returned
findings.evidence: Executed native Chromium: node /tmp/rifty-332-default-storage-probe.mjs; /tmp/rifty-332-default-storage-probe.log => [{"config":"omitted","vfs":{"backend":"memory"}},{"config":{"persistence":"preferred"},"vfs":{"backend":"memory","reason":"OPFS is unavailable in this realm"}}]. Probe disables only external native FileSystemFileHandle.prototype.createSyncAccessHandle, then boots real SDK and Worker via local Vite. Source at reviewed SHA was unchanged during probe.
